description: List things in the world or an area, filtered, a page at a time, nearest first. Read only.
help: List things in the world or an area, filtered, a page at a time, nearest first. Read only.
- thing: any object: structures, devices, tanks, loose items, players, animals

- item: stackable items and kits with quantity and holders, anywhere: ground, carried, stored, machine stock, silos; a kit such as Kit (Battery Large) is an item to find and move, a built structure is not; group_by sums them
- device: devices with logic, in the world or on one gateway's data networks
- container: outermost holders with at least one item: lockers, crates, machines, a backpack on the floor
- frame: outer frames (a face on outside air), with exposed faces and airtightness
- pad: landing pads for traders and rockets (not power or teleport pads), by the game's checks: size, runway, which ships fit
- water: canisters, tanks, devices and pipe networks holding water or steam, largest first
- ore: deep miner spots: the ore profile at a point, and the nearest spots holding given ores
- food: every food and drink: nutrition, hydration, decay, totals
- plant: plants in trays, planters and stations: stage, health, problems, time to harvest
- room: closed rooms measured cell by cell: volume, pressure, temperature, gases; or the room one thing is in
- gateway: the device scopes: 'world' and each StationGod Gateway with its status
- damaged: damaged and broken things in the world, worst first
Shaping on every call: fields, omit, list_limits, output_file, whole, repeat (help {topic: "shaping"}).
help {verb: "find", what} gives a what's options, reply keys and an example.

tool.what: thing: any object: structures, devices, tanks, loose items, players, animals; item: stackable items and kits with quantity and holders, anywhere: ground, carried, stored, machine stock, silos; a kit such as Kit (Battery Large) is an item to find and move, a built structure is not; group_by sums them; device: devices with logic, in the world or on one gateway's data networks; container: outermost holders with at least one item: lockers, crates, machines, a backpack on the floor; frame: outer frames (a face on outside air), with exposed faces and airtightness; pad: landing pads for traders and rockets (not power or teleport pads), by the game's checks: size, runway, which ships fit; water: canisters, tanks, devices and pipe networks holding water or steam, largest first; ore: deep miner spots: the ore profile at a point, and the nearest spots holding given ores; food: every food and drink: nutrition, hydration, decay, totals; plant: plants in trays, planters and stations: stage, health, problems, time to harvest; room: closed rooms measured cell by cell: volume, pressure, temperature, gases; or the room one thing is in; gateway: the device scopes: 'world' and each StationGod Gateway with its status; damaged: damaged and broken things in the world, worst first

options.prefab: Prefab: a whole name, a hash, or parts with * ('*Battery*', '*Tank*Insulated*': each part, any order); or a list of them.
options.category: Only this kind of thing. Default any.
options.location: thing: ground, player, stored, built or world (players, animals). Default any. item: Where the item is. Default any.
options.near: thing, item: Centre: [x, y, z], "player", "looking_at" or a thing's id (its position); with radius. container, frame, damaged: "player" only. ore: The point to report and search from; default the player's position.
options.box: Two corners [[x, y, z], [x, y, z]].
options.within: Only items inside this holder at any depth (and its machine stock or silo store).
options.group_by: holder: sum per holder and prefab; prefab: sum per prefab; place: per prefab split into ground, carried, stored, machine stock and silo, with top holders.
options.id: plant: One plant, in full. room: A thing: only the room it is in. Any what that takes an id takes a list: one row per id, {results: [{index, ok, reference_id, ...} or {index, ok, reference_id, error}], count, success_count, error_count}; a bad id is a row with error.
